string-array.name: glasstype_changelog
string-array.item: • Bigger keys: keyboard size 95 % instead of 77 %, font 100 % instead of 85 %, narrower key gaps (applies unless you changed these values yourself)
• New: Appearance → Key corners: Round, Medium or Like Gboard (only ?123 and Enter as capsules)
• The space bar shows "DE • EN" with a secondary language instead of the debug info
• Autocorrect: the default is now really "Balanced"; correctly spelled English words stay unchanged in German text (needs the English main dictionary)
• Downloaded or deleted dictionaries take effect right away, without a restart
• Toolbar: the arrow on the right only shows when keys are actually collapsed
• New: Suggestions → Width of suggestions (narrow / medium / wide), default medium: long words are shortened less often
• Clipboard, screenshot, code and calculation suggestions get as much room as their text needs, the toolbar keys collapse for it
• Crash fixed: with a secondary language (e.g. English) the keyboard could crash when two suggestion queries overlapped
• Typing: the space before a punctuation mark is only removed the first time. If you put it back at the same place, it stays
• Voice input: punctuation after a pause is no longer swallowed, the next word no longer sticks to the previous one
• Voice input: continuous listening without a restart after every pause (Android 13+)
• Voice input: if the keyboard has an additional language (e.g. English), voice input recognizes both languages (Android 14+)
• Voice input: selectable recognition service, language is passed with region (e.g. de-DE)
• New setting \"Minimum visible suggestions\" (default 3)
• Size of the icons: new default \"Automatic\", the icons only shrink when space is short
• Suggestions slightly wider on narrow screens, long words are truncated less often
• Voice input: in some apps (e.g. web apps) dictated words were replaced by the next word. Fixed
• Very narrow screens (Fold cover display): the arrow on the right always stays fully visible
• Narrow screens: next to suggestions only as many icons stay as leave room for 3 suggestions. The arrow on the right expands the rest (long press: lock)
• New option \"Size of the icons\" in the toolbar settings: normal, compact, small
• Transparency simplified: only real see-through, no permissions needed (\"home screen shines through\" removed)
• Umlaut keys also for the language \"German\" without region
• Own app icon
• Own version number and update check for GlassType releases
• About: GitHub link to GlassType, credits and link to LeanType
• Number row shown by default
• German: QWERTZ+ with umlaut keys by default, unsplit keyboard on unfolded foldables
• Gesture library download is verified by checksum
• Transparent mode, peek button, keyboard over app, built-in voice input
